events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed Willow reservation is visible: Meeting Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included, and Reservation total $245 with all charges included. The earlier room list showed Willow at $245 all-in versus Atlas at $280, supporting the budget-based choice.

Interpretação simulada: Willow satisfies all of Maya's constraints: it seats the 12-person meeting, includes the projector for the one-hour Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot, carries the Quarterly planning purpose, and its confirmed all-in total of $245 is within the strict $250 budget.

Limites: The date is shown only as Tomorrow without a calendar date. The site identifies itself as a demo venue and states reservations are saved only in this browser session; no payment was taken.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #9, #11, #13. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: All-in pricing made the budget-compliant room choice clear
findings.observation: The room list showed Atlas at an all-in $280 and Willow at an all-in $245. Willow listed 12 seats, the 10:00–11:00 one-hour slot with projector, a $235 room rate, $0 projector charge and $10 service fee.
findings.expected: A suitable room should seat 12, include a projector for the one-hour slot, and keep the complete cost at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and $250 budget stated in the saved charter.
findings.personaComment: I could see straight away that Willow kept me under budget while Atlas did not.
findings.interpretation: Showing the all-in total alongside the breakdown made it possible to choose a budget-compliant room confidently without estimating extra equipment or service charges.
findings.uncertainty: Prices and availability were observed for the displayed Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot in this session only.

findings.title: Confirmation preserved every required reservation detail
findings.observation: Review showed Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Willow on Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and a $245 total. Confirmation then showed Willow as Confirmed with Meeting Quarterly planning, Date and time Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included, and Reservation total $245 with all charges included.
findings.expected: The review and confirmed reservation should match the requested purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit success criteria and the saved charter's requirement to verify the final reservation details.
findings.personaComment: The confirmation shows exactly the meeting I asked for and the $245 total I expected.
findings.interpretation: The review and confirmation both preserved the same requirements and price, allowing the reservation to be verified against the budget and meeting needs before and after confirming.
findings.uncertainty: The confirmation uses the relative date label Tomorrow rather than a calendar date, and the page footer says reservations are saved only in this browser session.

finding.interpretation: Willow satisfies all of Maya's constraints: it seats the 12-person meeting, includes the projector for the one-hour Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot, carries the Quarterly planning purpose, and its confirmed all-in total of $245 is within the strict $250 budget.

learnings.confidenceBasis: The same Willow capacity, projector status, slot and $245 total appeared consistently on the room list, meeting step, review and confirmation screenshots.
learnings.content: For the displayed Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot, Willow provided 12 seats with projector included at an all-in total of $245 ($235 room, $0 projector, $10 service charge), while Atlas cost $280 all-in.

learnings.subject: Willow room suitability and total price

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Two rooms listed for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector required: Atlas all-in $280 and Willow all-in $245, both showing 12 seats and projector details.
experience.reaction: Willow looks like the one that keeps me under budget with room for all 12.

feedback.summary: All-in totals with fee breakdown let me spot Willow at $245 within budget versus Atlas at $280
feedback.why: Both rooms show 12 seats and 1 hr 10:00–11:00 with projector, so the visible all-in price directly determines which room meets my $250 limit without extra calculation.

experience.observation: Your meeting step for Willow shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, total $245, and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: I'll put in the meeting name so the reservation shows what it's for.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder example.
experience.reaction: Typing the meeting purpose as planned.

experience.observation: Meeting name now shows Quarterly planning; Willow summary still shows 12 people, projector included, total $245.
experience.reaction: Checking the review before I confirm anything.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12, Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people, total $245 with all charges included, and a Confirm reservation button.
experience.reaction: Everything matches what I need, so I'm confirming this room.

feedback.summary: Review page restates name, seating, projector and $245 all-in total before confirming
feedback.why: Seeing Quarterly planning with seating for 12, projector included, and the $235 + $0 + $10 breakdown lets me verify budget compliance before committing.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
